overview: Multilevel cross-sectional analysis of the 2025 school health survey linked, inside the custodian's secure analysis service, to counts of licensed tobacco retailers within 800 metres (road network) of each surveyed school.
population: Students in grades 8 to 12 in the 186 surveyed secondary schools (about 24,400 students).
exposure: Number of licensed retailers within 800 metres by road network on the 2026-07-01 licence list, grouped as none, 1 to 4, and 5 or more; no-retailer schools are the reference category.
procedures: The analyst sends the geocoded licence list to the custodian, who computes school buffers and returns only model outputs. Covariates: school socioeconomic index, neighbourhood deprivation of the school area, remoteness category, student age and sex.

outcomes.name: Current smoking
outcomes.measure: Any cigarette smoking in the past 30 days, self-reported
outcomes.why: Validated against cotinine in a comparable survey.

outcomes.name: Current vaping
outcomes.measure: Any vaping in the past 30 days, self-reported
outcomes.why: Now the most common product among students.

outcomes.name: Linkage completeness
outcomes.measure: Proportion of surveyed schools geocoded and linked
outcomes.why: Unlinked schools could bias the estimate.

feasibility: One analyst for four months; the custodian's service has run similar linkages; the licence list is already geocoded.
biasMitigation: Deprivation modelled at school and neighbourhood level
Road network buffers rather than straight-line distance
Analysis plan lodged with the custodian before outputs are seen

biasFlags.label: Residual confounding by deprivation
biasFlags.note: The main reason estimates differ between studies.

biasFlags.label: Self-reported outcomes
biasFlags.note: Smoking self-report is valid; vaping is not validated.

parsimony.simplestPath: One linkage, one exposure with three categories, two outcomes.

theoreticalFramework: None; a causal diagram fixes the covariate set.
summary: Multilevel cross-sectional linkage with two outcomes and five covariates, run inside the custodian's service.
